title: Kind filter uses two lists that disagree: Document never finds PowerPoint/Keynote, Code/Archive/Document miss files, and a typed *.ext is ignored
problem: The Kind filter is applied twice, from two lists. `search_root` appends the filter's extensions to the fff query (crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:645-648; lists in crates/fffinder-core/src/kind.rs:129-159), then drops every hit whose `classify()` kind fails `matches` (engine.rs:745-746; kind.rs:115-126). (a) `ppt`, `pptx` and `key` are in the Document extension list (kind.rs:134) but `classify` has no arm for them, so they are `FileKind::Other` (kind.rs:210) and `Document.matches` only accepts Pdf|Text|Data (kind.rs:119). Kind: Document can therefore never return a presentation, although the Kind column calls it 'PowerPoint Presentation' (kind.rs:310). (b) The other way round, extensions `classify` treats as code, data, text or archives (kind.rs:184-205) are missing from the lists, so the `*.ext` constraint excludes them: `htm`, `bat`, `cmd`, `cjs`, `mm`, `sass`, `less`, `proto` (Code); `crate` (Archive); `log`, `adoc`, `ini`, `jsonl`, `nuon`, `ods` (Document); and extension-less `README`/`LICENSE`/`Makefile` (kind.rs:214-232). (c) fff-search ORs all extension constraints (fff-search-0.11.0/src/index/constraints.rs:128-132 and 283-296), so with Kind: Image the query `logo *.svg` becomes `logo *.svg *.png *.jpg ...` and returns every image named logo; the user's own extension is lost. Every surface shares this: the Kind menu (src/finder/bars.rs:160-181), Smart Folders, `/v1/find?kind=` (src/server/mod.rs:389-393), `fff find --kind`, and `fff open`, which searches with `--kind document` (nu/fff.nu:335).
proposal: In crates/fffinder-core/src/kind.rs make the extension list the single source of truth: add `KindFilter::accepts(&self, path: &Path) -> bool` (Any and Folder unchanged; otherwise the lower-cased extension is in `extensions()`), and complete the lists from `classify`'s arms (the missing code, archive, text and data extensions; keep ppt/pptx/key and add odp). Follow `Document.matches` (Pdf|Text|Data) but leave binary stores such as sqlite/db/parquet out. In engine.rs:746 call `req.kind.accepts(&path)` instead of `req.kind.matches(kind)`. In engine.rs:645-648 do not append the kind's extensions when the user's query already has a `*.ext` token; the post-filter still enforces the kind, so the two are ANDed. Extension-less names stay a documented limit (add a sentence to the Kind menu row in docs/manual.md), or for Document only, run a second pass without the extension constraint when the first returns fewer than `limit` hits.
original_test_plan: kind.rs unit tests: for every `KindFilter` each extension in `extensions()` is accepted for `x.<ext>`; for a sample of `classify` results (htm -> Code, crate -> Archive, log -> Text) the matching filter accepts the file. engine.rs test modelled on `searches_a_folder` (engine.rs:2084): a temp root with deck.pptx, page.htm, notes.log, logo.svg, logo.png; kind Document with query `deck` finds deck.pptx; kind Code with query `page` finds page.htm; kind Image with query `logo *.svg` returns only logo.svg. tests/server.rs: `/v1/find?query=deck&kind=document` over the socket.
original_risks: Longer extension lists make the generated fff query longer (Code is already about 40 tokens; cost is negligible). Which Data types count as documents is a judgement call. Skipping the kind's extensions when the user typed one relies on the post-filter, so the over-fetch at engine.rs:665-669 has to stay.

verifier.claim_check:
All three sub-claims hold; I could not refute any of them. No other handler compensates, and neither docs/manual.md nor CHANGELOG.md describes the behaviour as intentional.

The Kind filter is applied twice in `search_root`:
- crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:645-648 appends ` *.ext` for every `req.kind.extensions()`.
- engine.rs:745-746 then drops every hit unless `req.kind.matches(kind::classify(&path, false))`.
- These are the only callers of `extensions()` and `matches()` in the repo. The UI (src/finder/mod.rs:1383), Smart Folders (src/finder/filter.rs:191/226), `/v1/find` (src/server/mod.rs:389-414) and nu/fff.nu:167/335 all go through `Engine::search`.

(a) Presentations can never be returned.
- `ppt`, `pptx`, `key` are in the Document list (crates/fffinder-core/src/kind.rs:134).
- `classify` has no arm for them, so they fall to `FileKind::Other` (kind.rs:210).
- `Document.matches` accepts only Pdf|Text|Data (kind.rs:119), so fff returns deck.pptx and line 746 discards it.
- `kind_label` still calls it "PowerPoint Presentation" (kind.rs:310).

(b) Extensions `classify` recognises but the lists omit, so the fff constraint excludes them:
- Code arm (kind.rs:195-200): cjs, mm, pl, r, exs, erl, clj, htm, sass, less, bat, cmd, vim, el, nim, wgsl, glsl, metal, proto, graphql, cmake, mk. That is 22, more than the candidate listed.
- Archive: crate.
- Text: log, adoc.
- Data: jsonl, nuon, ini, plist, sqlite, sqlite3, db, parquet, ods, lock, ron, env, conf, cfg.
- Extension-less README/Makefile and similar (kind.rs:209, 214-232) classify as Text but can never pass a `*.ext` constraint.
- The Image, Movie and Audio lists match their `classify` arms exactly.

(c) A typed extension is lost under a kind.
- fff-search ORs all Extension constraints (fff-search-0.11.0/src/index/constraints.rs:128-132, 200-207, 283-296).
- `*.ext` parses to `Constraint::Extension` under `FileSearchConfig` (fff-query-parser-0.11.0/src/parser.rs:280-294).
- So Kind Image + `logo *.svg` returns every image named logo, and Kind Image + `logo *.txt` returns all images too, because the txt hits are post-filtered away.

Docs and tests:
- manual.md:346 documents only that typed extensions OR with each other; manual.md:338 just lists the kinds.
- No test pins the buggy behaviour. Existing kind tests are engine.rs:2120-2127 (Image, empty query -> photo.png), engine.rs:2199-2202 (Document "notes" -> terminal-notes.txt), tests/server.rs:139-141 (kind=document -> Roadmap.md) and tests/controls.rs:373-389 (Folder kind). All stay valid under the proposal.
verifier.implementation_notes:
The proposal is sound. Four refinements.

1. kind.rs: add the predicate and remove the old one.
- Add `pub fn accepts(self, path: &Path) -> bool`: Any => true; Folder => false (folders come from `fuzzy_search_directories` at engine.rs:696-710 and never reach this predicate); otherwise `self.extensions().contains(&extension(path).as_str())`. Reuse the private `extension()` helper at kind.rs:167, which already lower-cases; fff's `file_has_extension` is case-insensitive too.
- Delete `KindFilter::matches` rather than leaving a second predicate. Its only callers are engine.rs:746 and the `kind_filter_groups` test (kind.rs:347-349), which should be rewritten with `accepts`. fffinder-core is a workspace-internal crate, so this breaks nothing external.

2. kind.rs: complete the lists.
- Code: add cjs, mm, pl, r, exs, erl, clj, htm, sass, less, bat, cmd, vim, el, nim, wgsl, glsl, metal, proto, graphql, cmake, mk.
- Archive: add crate.
- Document: add log, adoc, jsonl, nuon, ini, ods, plist, ron, conf, cfg, env, odp; keep ppt/pptx/key.
- Document: deliberately leave out sqlite, sqlite3, db, parquet and lock (Cargo.lock/yarn.lock noise), with a comment saying so.
- Do not touch `classify`. It drives icons and the Kind column, and making pptx Text would change icons.
- `classify` stays a second list, so guard drift with a unit test (see test plan).

3. engine.rs:645-648: skip the kind's extensions only when the user typed a positive extension constraint.
- Detect with fff's own parser rather than a hand-rolled token check: `QueryParser::default().parse(user).constraints.iter().any(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Extension(_)))`.
- Add `Constraint` to the `fff_search` import at engine.rs:11-16; it is re-exported through `pub use fff_query_parser::*` (fff-search lib.rs:177).
- This correctly ignores `!*.log` (Not(Extension), already ANDed), `\*.rs` (escaped) and `*.test.*` or `src/**/*.rs` (Glob, ANDed), so the kind's extensions are still appended as a prefilter in those cases.
- `user` at that point is already past `split_quoted` and `fold_glob_case` (engine.rs:525-529), which leave alphanumeric `*.ext` tokens untouched (engine.rs:1639-1641).

4. engine.rs:745-746: replace `kind::classify` + `req.kind.matches(kind)` with `req.kind.accepts(&path)`.
- The `kind` module import is still needed for engine.rs:1385.
- This branch is only reached for kind != Folder, including Any + files_only, where `accepts` returns true as `matches` did.
- Keep the over-fetch at engine.rs:665-669.

Extension-less names: document the limit only. Skip the proposed second pass; it would need the 20k over-fetch plus a name allowlist for little gain.

Docs:
- docs/manual.md:338 (Kind menu row): say kinds go by extension, so README/Makefile-style names are not matched, and a typed `*.ext` narrows within the kind.
- CHANGELOG.md: add a `### Fixed` section under `## [Unreleased]`, which currently has only Added and Changed.
- The Search Syntax dialog (src/finder/dialogs.rs:958, 974) and docs/protocol.md:65 need no change.

All of this is plain cross-platform Rust.
verifier.test_plan:
Unit tests only; no UI-harness test is needed (tests/controls.rs `scope_bar_controls`, lines 361-389, already covers the Kind menu and is unaffected).

1. crates/fffinder-core/src/kind.rs, `mod tests`:
- Rewrite `kind_filter_groups` (kind.rs:346) with `accepts`: Document accepts a.pdf, deck.PPTX, notes.log; rejects a.png, x.sqlite and extension-less README; Any accepts anything.
- Drift guard: for Image, Movie, Audio, Code and Archive, every ext in `extensions()` must `classify("x.<ext>", false)` to exactly the matching FileKind.
- Drift guard for Document: every ext must classify to Pdf|Text|Data or be in the explicit allowlist [ppt, pptx, key, odp].
- No extension appears in two filters' lists.
- Reverse samples: htm, proto, bat accepted by Code; crate by Archive; jsonl, nuon by Document.

2. crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs, `mod tests`: new test `kind_filter_goes_by_extension`.
- Model the setup on `searches_a_folder` (engine.rs:2084) and the `find` closure from `finds_apps_without_indexing_them` (engine.rs:2170-2184).
- Use a unique temp dir such as `fff-kinds-{pid}`, `Engine::new(EngineOptions { roots: vec![dir], app_dirs: vec![], db_dir: None, watch: false, search: Default::default() })`, then `wait_ready(10s)`.
- Files: deck.pptx, page.htm, notes.log, logo.svg, logo.png, logo.txt.
- Assert: Document + `deck` -> [deck.pptx]; Code + `page` -> [page.htm]; Document + `notes` -> [notes.log].
- Assert: Image + `logo` -> {logo.svg, logo.png}; Image + `logo *.svg` -> [logo.svg]; Image + `logo *.txt` -> empty; Image + `logo !*.png` -> [logo.svg].

3. Must keep passing unchanged: engine.rs:2120-2127, engine.rs:2199-2202, tests/server.rs:139-141.

4. Do not add the `deck` case to tests/server.rs as proposed.
- The shared `Fixture::new` tree is pinned to exactly 3 files (tests/server.rs:102, 145, 211) and the index is built with watch=false.
- Line 139 already covers the `kind=` plumbing.
- If a socket-level test is still wanted, write the extra file in a new test before `fx.engine(false)`, not in `Fixture::new`.
verifier.risks:
- `.key` is also the usual name for TLS/SSH private-key files; once the filter works they appear under Kind: Document.
- `fff open` (nu/fff.nu:335) takes the top `--kind document` hit, so it can now pick a pptx, key or log file that Nushell's `open` does not read as structured data. Against that, it gains nuon, jsonl, ini and ods, which it could not find before.
- Adding `log`, `conf`, `cfg` and `plist` makes Document results noisier in developer trees.
- Typed `*.ext` plus a Kind becomes AND. A saved Smart Folder such as Kind Image + `*.txt`, which used to show all images, will now show nothing. That is correct but visible, so the CHANGELOG should say so.
- With a typed extension outside the kind, `total_matched` over-counts. It is only stored (src/finder/mod.rs:1413) and never displayed.
- When the user types several extensions and only some belong to the kind, the kind is enforced by the post-filter alone. More than about 2,000 higher-ranked hits of the foreign extension could crowd out valid ones. This is negligible; an exact alternative is to replace the typed extensions with their intersection with the kind's list.
- `classify` remains a separate list for icons and labels, so the drift test is the only guard against the two diverging again.
- Query length grows to about 62 extension tokens for Code. The parser uses a plain Vec and the constraint plan a spilling SmallVec, so there is no capacity limit, and the per-item cost is trivial.
